title: Fidget spinner
about: a three-lobed spinner with press-fit pockets for four 608 bearings and two finger caps
tries: Make it a two-lobed spinner with 5/8 in hex nuts as weights | Give the lobes coin pockets for 2 euro coins instead of bearings | Why does the rounding fail when the arms are 12 mm wide?

agent.role: a toy designer who builds around standard bearings and fit classes
agent.prompt: Prefer bearing sizes from ISO 15 tables and pockets from j.fit.hole; keep the body as thick as the bearing; never put a fillet on an edge that touches the bed.

fragments.fit: Size every pocket with j.fit.hole(d, 'press') so a calibrated profile resizes it.
